Resolves #19855

Neo's copy of the Neural Link capability matrix is gone. The Brain's copy, received in neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1118 (`51e91ce0`) under the [custody decision](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-brain/issues/1117#issuecomment-6246813526), is now the only one. `NeuralLink.md` (twice) and `DockLayoutsTesting.md` link to it on the Brain's `blob/dev`, and the tree entry is gone. `NeuralLink.md` also stops claiming an operation count: it said 59, and the registry holds 60.

Related: neomjs/neo-agent-brain#201

Evidence: L1 (static: `git grep` census, `tree.json` parse, `check-relative-links`) + L2 (the learn-tree unit specs; an in-memory SEO render of the head tree) → L2 required (docs, no runtime AC). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Outside CI: `git grep NeuralLinkCapabilityMatrix` at head finds the three Brain links plus `apps/portal/llms.txt:406` and `apps/portal/sitemap.xml:170`. Those two are pipeline-owned output, covered by AC-2. Nothing is lost: the Brain's copy is a superset of the deleted one, adding `drive_drag` and repository-qualified ticket references. |
| AC-2 | The tree no longer holds `agentos/tooling/NeuralLinkCapabilityMatrix`, and the in-memory render (Test Evidence) shows the next rebuild drops the page. The committed output waits for the pipeline (guide-authoring bar §5). |
| AC-3 | This body links the decision and the received revision `51e91ce0`. |
| AC-4 | Outside CI: `NeuralLink.md` contains no "operation IDs". |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. Intake sharpened the ticket body with a Contract Ledger and the Brain half's measured state. Today the arm fails `ENOENT` and its count assertion is unconditional, so the Brain PR must re-point it, make the count conditional and move the commit-tarball pin.

## Test Evidence
- In-memory SEO render: `getLlmsTxt` and `getSitemapXml` from `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs`, run on the head tree with an empty corpus, produce 377 `llms.txt` lines and 300 sitemap `<loc>`s. Neither has the matrix, and both still carry `NeuralLink`, so the probe can fail.
- `GuideToolParity`'s guide-side assertions, replayed on the edited `NeuralLink.md`: no tool-table rows, `ai/mcp/server/neural-link/openapi.yaml` and `get_mcp_tool_handbook` present, no count claim.
